_kommentar: Moodboards pro Region (ART_BIBLE §2/§10). 8 Bilder je Region. Prompt = shot + context + style. Englisch, weil FLUX englische Prompts am besten versteht.
style: cinematic film still, photorealistic, dark fairytale realism, volumetric atmosphere, physically based lighting, subtle film grain, anamorphic 35mm lens, high dynamic range, intricate detail

groups.context: an ancient magic academy of grey granite and pale limestone towers with green oxidized copper roofs, built on a humming sea cliff above a deep dark lake, two moons in the sky (one large silver, one small rust red)

shots.prompt: wide establishing shot of the academy on the cliff at golden hour, warm sunlight on the towers, cold blue mist over the lake, a small wooden boat with lanterns crossing the water

interior of the great hall, gothic stone vaults, hundreds of floating candles, a giant bronze tuning bell hanging from the ceiling, stained glass windows casting colored light shafts through incense haze
vast candlelit library with spiral wooden staircases, dust motes in golden light beams, brass reading lamps, old leather books, a locked iron gate to a forbidden section
cloister courtyard at night in heavy rain, wet cobblestones reflecting warm lantern light, moss in the stone joints, puddles with rain splashes
macro close-up of mossy weathered granite wall with candle wax drips and an engraved brass plaque, shallow depth of field
the dark lake at night under two moons, mist on the water, the academy windows glowing warm in the distance, a sunken bell visible under the clear water
students in dark grey wool coats with colored scarves walking across a stone bridge between towers, autumn leaves, morning fog
color key painting style but photoreal: granite grey, copper green and candle gold palette, the academy silhouette against a sunset sky

groups.context: an ancient whispering forest of gigantic moss-covered oaks and beeches, mushroom rings, roots like cathedrals

shots.prompt: wide shot deep in the forest at dawn, god rays through dense fog between enormous trunks, ferns and moss carpets
enchanted clearing with a ring of glowing blue mushrooms around an old standing stone, fireflies, twilight
a path leading through a tunnel of huge twisted roots, lanterns hung by forest keepers, mist
forest in steady rain, wet bark, droplets on spider webs, muted green and brown palette, soft overcast light
macro close-up of tree bark overgrown with moss, lichens and tiny mushrooms, dew drops
the forest at night lit only by bioluminescent moths with glowing wing patterns, deep blue darkness
a silver-grey fox dissolving partly into fog on a mossy log, looking at the camera, misty forest background
palette of moss green, bark brown and glimmering cyan accents, backlit forest silhouette

groups.context: a mountain village in a deep valley basin with steaming hot springs, half-timbered houses with slate roofs, a market square, mine entrances in the cliffs

shots.prompt: wide shot of the village in the valley at golden hour, steam rising from hot springs, mountains around, smoke from chimneys
busy market square with wooden stalls, lanterns, merchants selling crystals, herbs and tuning staffs, warm afternoon light
cluttered workshop of an old instrument maker, crystals, brass tools, a bandoneon on a workbench, warm lamp light through dusty air
the village in winter snowfall at dusk, warm windows, footprints in snow, steam from springs
close-up of a half-timbered wall with weathered oak beams, lime plaster cracks and wrought iron lantern
narrow cobblestone alley at night, lanterns, wet stones, a cat on a stair, steam drifting
entrance of an old crystal mine with wooden supports, mine carts, glowing quartz veins in rock
palette of ochre timber, slate blue roofs and lantern orange accents

groups.context: a vast fog-covered moor with peat bogs, dead trees and the ruins of an old fortress, a stilt village of forest keepers

shots.prompt: wide shot of the misty moor with the broken towers of a ruined fortress in the distance, overcast cold light
inside crumbling fortress ruins overgrown with heather, arches half sunk in the bog, eerie green will-o-wisp lights
a village of wooden huts on stilts above black water, rope bridges, hanging herbs, lanterns in fog
the moor in heavy rain, rippling dark water, reeds bending in wind
close-up of peat, wet moss, bog water and rotting wood, muted browns
night on the moor, pale green floating lights luring into the darkness, thick ground fog, moonlight
a huge toad with glowing blisters on its back sitting in reeds, fog, ominous
palette of peat brown, fog grey and sickly bright green accents

groups.context: a vast underground cave system with crystal lakes, giant turquoise crystals, bioluminescent violet mushrooms and ancient mines

shots.prompt: wide shot of an enormous cavern with an underground lake, glowing turquoise crystals reflected in still water
ancient carved mine tunnels with geometric reliefs, old scaffolding, crystal veins glowing
forest of giant violet bioluminescent mushrooms in a cave, spores floating
underground waterfall falling into a crystal pool, mist, cold light
macro close-up of translucent crystal growing from dark wet rock
silhouette of a gigantic whale with crystal plates instead of skin swimming in a glowing underground lake
a young mage with a glowing tuning staff exploring a narrow crystal tunnel, light only from the staff
palette of near-black, crystal turquoise and violet accents

groups.context: a rugged harbor town on steep chalk cliffs, whitewashed houses, fishing boats, warehouses, a lighthouse with a wind bell

shots.prompt: wide shot of the harbor town on chalk cliffs in stormy weather, waves crashing, gulls, dramatic clouds
busy harbor quay with tall sailing ships, nets, barrels, fishermen in oilskin coats, overcast light
old lighthouse on a cliff at night, sweeping light beam through fog and rain
narrow steep alley with stairs between white houses, red doors, laundry lines, sea fog
close-up of salt-crusted wooden pier planks, rusty iron rings and wet ropes
harbor tavern at night with warm windows, wet cobblestones, a woman detective in an oilskin coat
a giant octopus arm with salt-encrusted skin rising from the harbor water beside a ship
palette of chalk white, sea grey-blue and signal red accents

groups.context: towering snowy alpine peaks and glaciers, a remote monastery of silent monks with saffron prayer flags

shots.prompt: epic wide shot of jagged snowy peaks and a glacier at sunrise, tiny monastery on a ridge
stone monastery courtyard with saffron flags in wind, snow, monks in heavy robes
blue ice cave inside a glacier, light filtering through the ice
a narrow mountain path in a blizzard, low visibility, a lone traveler with a lantern
close-up of frost crystals on dark rock and old prayer flag cloth
snowy peaks under a starry sky with two moons, aurora-like faint glow
a white wolf pack with ice crystals in their fur on a snowy ridge, breath steaming
palette of snow white, glacier blue and saffron accents

groups.context: a deep red sandstone desert canyon with the ruins of an ancient civilization, carved resonance towers and giant faceless statues

shots.prompt: wide shot of a monumental red canyon with ancient carved city ruins in the walls, harsh midday sun, heat haze
tall carved stone towers with holes like flutes, sand blowing through them, golden light
interior of an ancient tomb with gold inlaid inscriptions glowing faintly, light shaft from above
approaching sandstorm in the canyon, orange darkness, ruins in silhouette
close-up of eroded sandstone with carved geometric glyphs inlaid with gold
the canyon at night under a huge silver moon, cold blue light on red rock
a giant sand-colored worm with a trumpet-shaped mouth bursting out of dunes
palette of red sandstone, dust beige and ancient gold accents

groups.context: floating islands high above a sea of clouds, waterfalls falling off their edges, ancient ruins and wind currents

shots.prompt: epic wide shot of floating islands above a cloud sea at sunrise, waterfalls dissolving into mist
overgrown ancient stone ruins on a floating island, wildflowers, wind
a rider on a griffin-like creature (snowy owl front, lynx body) flying between floating islands, motion
thunderstorm among the floating islands, lightning, dark clouds below
close-up of the underside of a floating island: roots, rocks and glowing veins
floating islands at night, stars and two moons above the cloud sea
a school of translucent flying manta rays gliding through clouds

groups.context: a grand capital city of white marble and gold domes, seat of a magocratic government, huge bell towers, with a dark slum quarter in a ravine below

shots.prompt: wide shot of the marble capital with gold domes and bell towers, bright cold sunlight, imposing
vast marble council chamber with blue banners and a golden bell, officials in white coats
dark overcrowded slum quarter in a ravine under the marble city, laundry, smoke, graffiti of finch birds
grand boulevard in rain, marble reflecting grey sky, guards with halberds
close-up of polished white marble with gold inlay and blue enamel
the capital at night, bell towers glowing faintly blue, curfew, empty squares
endless archive halls with sealed files, a single lamp, dust

groups.context: a parallel shadow realm of everything that was unmade, desaturated grey world, light coming from below, bright shadows, floating debris of houses and temples

shots.prompt: wide shot of a desaturated ghost town floating in fragments in a grey void, inverted lighting from below
broken houses, ships and temple pillars floating silently in the air, dust
a translucent woman with golden glowing lines on dark skin floating, hair drifting as if underwater
faceless porcelain-smooth humanoid figures made of broken objects, round open mouth, grey void
close-up of colorless cracked stone with a faint violet-white glow in the cracks
a path of floating stones leading to a pale violet-white light, negative-film look
the silhouette of a burned town in the void, everything grey except a single warm light
palette of ash grey, negative violet and undertone white
